title: A scripted walk can put a frame around what is selected
goal: An unmanned run cannot currently check any feature that needs a screen on the canvas unless it draws one by hand with the frame tool: asking the app to put a frame around what is selected, the way the Layer menu does, freezes the scripted run and it never finishes. Make that step work, so frame-shaped UI building work can be verified the same way everything else is.
notes: Found 2026-09-04 while writing Scripts/playtest/panel-shows-landing-walk.json. A walk containing {"do":"frameSelection"} produces no log.json and no done.json at all: the run hangs inside the step, so Scripts/playtest.sh times out with an empty output folder. Bisected: the identical walk with that one step removed completes. Harness site: PlaytestHarness.swift case .frameSelection -> editor.frameSelection(). Suspect a sheet or an alert put up on the main actor that nothing dismisses, or a wait on something the harness never satisfies. Workaround in use: pick the frame tool and drag a rectangle in document space.
acceptance: A walk step that frames the selection completes and the run reaches its last step
The frame it makes holds the layer that was selected, proven by the state line in the walk log
An existing walk is added or updated to cover it, and it passes
